# Export & Deletion Requirements Checklist: Export & Deletion Completion (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 016 — secrecy of the download link and no file in app storage, bounded polling, refusal coverage, the new-owner step's fidelity to the server's successor rule, honest copy, and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): privacy of the link first, then the deletion successor step, then polling and refusals, then contract fidelity and UX completeness; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, research or contracts in the same session; each says where. `[x]` = reviewed and holds (or fixed); unchecked items are left for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified what tapping an export in the list does? [Gap → fixed: FR-005 "tapping a row opens that export's screen"]
- [x] CHK002 Is the handling of a refused page position (`INVALID_CURSOR`) on the list specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-005, contracts/export-deletion-client.md]
- [x] CHK003 Does the export's screen say which export it is (everything or which wallet)? [Gap → fixed: FR-012 "MUST name its kind"]
- [x] CHK004 Is polling's behaviour on returning to the foreground defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-011 "Returning to the foreground reads once and resumes…"]
- [x] CHK005 Is the pending view defined when the plan cannot be read? [Gap → fixed: FR-031 last sentence]
- [x] CHK006 Is the result of saving changed owners during the grace period defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-031 "New owners saved." and same date; contracts copy `delete_owners_saved`]
- [x] CHK007 Is every code the backend lists for `POST /exports`, `GET /exports`, `GET /exports/{id}` and the deletion-request operations mapped or explicitly generic? [Completeness, FR-017–FR-023, FR-028, Spec §5, contracts/export-deletion-client.md]
- [x] CHK008 Is the order of candidates in the new-owner choice specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-025 suggested first, then joined date]
- [x] CHK009 Is it defined when a choice is offered vs. not (wallet or members not on the phone)? [Gap → fixed: FR-025 last sentence; Edge Cases; data-model `choiceOffered`]
- [x] CHK010 Are entry points for every role specified (owner/editor/viewer, archived wallets, unsynced wallets)? [Completeness, FR-002, research R-06]
- [x] CHK011 Is the `purging` state's client behaviour specified even though it is invisible? [Completeness, FR-032, research R-11]
- [x] CHK012 Are E2E routes to every story specified, including the purge for US6? [Completeness, contracts/ui-and-e2e.md "Deferred E2E", quickstart §2.5]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK013 Is the polling cadence and every stop condition stated as measurable values? [Clarity, FR-010, FR-011, SC-004]
- [x] CHK014 Is the file size format defined? [Gap → fixed: FR-012 "under 1 MB in KB rounded up, otherwise MB with one decimal"]
- [x] CHK015 Is the rate-limit wait rounding defined (hours/minutes rounded up; none → "later")? [Clarity, FR-020, research R-04]
- [x] CHK016 Is "Former member" defined as a testable rule, including when members are not yet known? [Clarity, FR-033, clarification 5]
- [x] CHK017 Is the content of the request's `successors` defined exactly (which wallets, which member, cap, omission)? [Clarity, FR-027, research R-08]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK018 Do US4-6 and FR-026 agree about the date on the review? [Conflict → fixed: both say "after 30 days"; the review computes no date]
- [x] CHK019 Do the spec, research and data model agree on when a choice is offered? [Conflict → fixed: `candidates.any { !it.unknown }` in research R-07 and data-model]
- [x] CHK020 Does the brief's "`export.enabled` may gate" conflict with FR-004? [Resolved: superseded by spec 022 A-5; clarification 1; Spec §6]
- [x] CHK021 Does the brief's "CSV/XLSX" conflict with the copy? [Resolved: no XLSX (spec 022 A-1); FR-018 forbids mentioning it; string scan]
- [x] CHK022 Does the brief's "browser or share sheet" conflict with FR-014? [Resolved: browser only, clarification 2, recorded as an assumed default]
- [x] CHK023 Is spec 002's "requests are never retried or queued" kept for the plan read and the changed request? [Consistency, FR-029]

## Security & Privacy

- [x] CHK024 Is every place the link could leak named (state, DB, prefs, logs, crash, analytics, UI, clipboard, share sheet)? [Completeness, FR-014, invariant table]
- [x] CHK025 Is it required that every type carrying the link prints it redacted? [Clarity, FR-014, research R-02]
- [x] CHK026 Is it required that the app never writes the file and that a test proves it? [Coverage, FR-015, invariant "scan test"]
- [x] CHK027 Is the password in the changed request body protected from printing? [Gap → fixed: FR-037]
- [x] CHK028 Does the copy avoid naming other members in exports, and does the new-owner step show only names the phone already holds? [Coverage, FR-018, FR-025]
- [x] CHK029 Is it ensured that the signed link cannot route back into the app via App Links? [Coverage, research R-02 "App Links" + manifest test]

- [x] CHK030 Are success criteria measurable without implementation knowledge? [Measurability, SC-001–SC-007]
